name: Discuss GitHub bugs with AI reviewers and optional BVC call savings

nodes.name: Configure approved input
nodes.notes: Owner setup: choose provider + model and matching Header Auth. The form can change only issue/files/BVC. Yandex is optional. See README for provider choices.

parameters.formTitle: Let AI reviewers discuss a bug

values.fieldLabel: Issue number — the problem to discuss
Commit SHA — the version to read
Files to read — one path per line

values.defaultValue: Use BVC to skip unnecessary discussion

values.option: Use BVC to skip unnecessary discussion

parameters.formDescription: Describe the problem in a GitHub issue and choose the files to read. Four AI roles consider a solution. With BVC checked, they may skip an unnecessary extra round. Your API account pays for the calls. No code is changed. The result appears here; keep this page open.

parameters.content:
# Discuss GitHub bugs with AI reviewers and optional BVC call savings

Get several perspectives on a software bug before deciding what to change. This template creates a proposal for a person to review; it does not edit code.

### How it works

Open the form, choose a GitHub issue and the files to read, and start the discussion. Four AI roles examine the same source version: an architect, developer, reviewer and tester. They cannot see each other's first answers. These are four roles of your selected model, not necessarily four different models.

The **Use BVC** checkbox lets the original Xynapse planning algorithm decide whether another discussion round is worthwhile. Leave it unchecked for a fixed extra round when the budget allows. Choose a maximum of five or nine model calls during setup. One call is always reserved for the final plan. Skipping critique can avoid four calls; token or cost savings are not guaranteed.

The form displays the proposal and a technical audit. Incomplete or refused final answers are rejected. No code changes, GitHub comments or pull requests are created. Verification is always `not_run`.

### Setup

1. Import into n8n 2.37.10 with JavaScript Code nodes enabled.
2. In **Configure approved input**, choose your provider, model and five/nine-call limit. See README for OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek, Yandex and compatible APIs.
3. Bind GitHub read-only Header Auth to eight GitHub nodes and the matching model credential to nine Model nodes. Your provider account pays for API calls.
4. Test the form, or run **Start manually** and open **Final report**. Publish locally for a reusable form; access requires an authorized n8n login.

No Xynapse installation or custom node is needed. Self-hosted n8n is tested; n8n Cloud remains unverified.

## 1. Read approved evidence
Select the issue and files. Resolve the commit once; every file read uses that SHA. GitHub access is read-only.

## 2. Analyze independently
Four roles receive the same source context. Initial answers are isolated. BVC then evaluates whether further critique is worth its cost.

## 3. Choose whether to discuss again
BVC on: the SDK decides whether critique is worthwhile. BVC off: its fixed baseline uses one extra round when the budget permits. One call always remains for the final plan.

## 4. Read the proposal
The form displays the plan and an expandable audit. Manual runs expose reportMarkdown in Final report. Incomplete synthesis produces no accepted plan. A person must check the proposal; verification = not_run.
